## Outcome

Describe the user or maintainer problem and the result.

## Compatibility

- [ ] No public contract change
- [ ] Backward-compatible addition
- [ ] Deprecation
- [ ] Behavior change
- [ ] Breaking change

Describe any impact on the fluent API, failure diagnostics, Java, QuickFIX/J, AssertJ Core, Maven dependencies, or dictionary behavior.

## Verification

- [ ] Focused behavior tests added or updated
- [ ] QuickFIX/J 2.3.2 and 3.0.2 checked when applicable
- [ ] Packaged-consumer test updated when applicable
- [ ] `mvn --batch-mode verify` passes

List the commands and important results.

## Documentation and release notes

- [ ] User documentation updated, or not required
- [ ] Migration guidance added, or not required
- [ ] Release-note impact described, or not required

## Branch and release line

State the target branch and whether a compatible 1.0.x backport is appropriate.

## Rollback

Describe how to disable or revert the change.
